decisions.question: Which exact Products require freight/delivery messaging, which approved shipping profiles and destinations apply, and what exact customer wording/contact route may be shown?
requiredEvidence: Product GIDs and shipping profile mapping
decisions.defaultBehavior: Existing native Shopify shipping/tax note; no new promise

decisions.question: Should optional cart notes or purchase-order/contact guidance be offered, and what approved copy and handling channel apply?
requiredEvidence: Named staff handling and privacy expectations
decisions.defaultBehavior: Notes remain disabled; native cart entry unchanged

decisions.owner: Product Owner / Epic G commercial owner
decisions.question: For each exact unresolved Product/Variant, what disposition and any specific warning/restriction is explicitly approved?
requiredEvidence: G006 MR16 price and specification disposition
Exact Product-level customer copy and enforcement authority if desired
decisions.defaultBehavior: Published native zero-price Products remain purchasable; no arbitrary threshold rule

decisions.question: Should existing checkout/express placement change, and what verified payment eligibility and discount workflow should customers use?
requiredEvidence: Actual payment provider and wallet eligibility
Approved discount-code expectation without creating promotions
decisions.defaultBehavior: Retain existing native entry and provider eligibility; no new payment method claim

decisions.question: Is any cart compatibility or required-accessory guidance needed, with which exact approved meaning, complete source set, copy and lifecycle?
requiredEvidence: Current E/F relationship authority and audience
G003 private revocation and production operating policy
decisions.defaultBehavior: No compatibility warning, cross-sell or required accessory inference
